name: MVGS_CS_PREVENTIVE_MEASURE_RESULT
title: MV-GenomSeq preventive measure result
description: Result of a preventive (early-detection) measure for hereditary tumour cases, KDK followUp.followUpOds[].preventiveMeasures[].preventiveMeasureResult. No MII concept exists (DISCUSS-TD #5). The concept 'preventive-measure-result' is the observable used as Observation.code; the other concepts are its values.

concept.definition: Observable: outcome of a preventive / early-detection examination recommended for a hereditary tumour predisposition.
The examination showed no pathological findings.
The examination detected a malignant tumour.
The examination showed a finding that needs clarification.
